items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the projective space bundle formula at source lines 4380-4403, label lemma-chow-ring-projective-bundle, whose proof occupies source lines 4405-4512. The two halves are different in kind. Injectivity is a short computation that must be iterated: the pushforward of the universal combination returns the top component, and multiplying by the Chern class before pushing forward strips one component at a time. Surjectivity is a reduction and induction: the class is decomposed into classes of integral closed subspaces, the statement is proved on the fibre products over their images and reassembled through locally finite sums, which reduces to an integral base and a single dominating subspace, and the induction on the dimension of the base shrinks to an open subspace, lifts cycles from the open and disposes of the difference through the exact sequence of the complement before quoting the scheme case. The counted statement records neither the induction nor the decomposition.
